summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. filed Form 6-K with a news release announcing a quarterly dividend of US$0.195 per share, an 18% increase year-over-year, payable on or about June 9, 2026, to holders of record as of May 27, 2026. The board declared the dividend, which is an eligible dividend for Canadian tax purposes. The company also maintains a Dividend Reinvestment Plan (DRIP) with treasury issuance at average market price without discount. This is a routine dividend declaration and not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special-situation event is present.
